title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 167
paragraphs: That is the story of Phocaea in Ionia. The people of Teos did much the same thing. As soon as Harpagos captured their wall with a siege ramp, they boarded their ships and sailed to Thrace. There they founded the city of Abdera. (A man from Clazomenai named Timesios had actually founded Abdera before them, but the Thracians drove him out. He is now honored as a hero by the Teans in Abdera.)
